Prepare erase History before semantic apply using existing transaction support; keep synchronous operation acceptance/publication ownership. Do not redesign all History or add threads.
Remove deferred next-Down dependency on canonical rendering only after retained-feedback/Scene-readiness paths are installed. Do not merely delete the present call and old clearing checks.

Keep latest committed state usable for new input and derived visual demands. Retry render at existing frame opportunities with bounded progress, preserve completed work, respect current budgets, terminal cancel/lost and canonical fairness.

Only eligible sealed feedback associated with actually accepted complete exact work may be retired at strict completion. Freeze replacement set before submit and do not expand it at capture or completion.

Execute native safety/regressions, build matched normal candidate from current accepted UR1a sources, run two fixed targeted browser functional workers, publish a new candidate Demo, then notify control.

browser_window.restore: Reuse explicit r2 caller-owned binding1 and independent source/live/checkpoint clocks. No new seed. Existing metadata read-only. Ordinary candidate generation differs from saved external revision.
browser_window.safety: Freeze source/driver/artifact before start; charge actual ceil duration and owned cleanup, unknown interruption full reservation. Record all failures with raw errors/contacts. One resource/identity/hard timeout stops further workers; no hidden retries. Product failure blocks candidate acceptance. Missing browser evidence is explicit, not a request to rebuild a broad harness.

terminal_blockers.behavior: Preserve code and every result; explicitly mark incomplete items. Independent browser failures limit browser conclusion. Do not claim success or reopen old windows.
